name: Tax Executive Summary — Riley 2025, Happy Path
query: I've got a review with David and Victoria Riley at 2:00 — pull up their latest return and walk me through their tax picture before I go in.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Calls find_client with 'Riley' — not get_clients alone
Step 2: Calls get_lookback_report for the household with no taxYear specified, so the most recent filed year is used
Step 3: Calls get_federal_tax_constants for that year to support the capital-gains and IRMAA sections
Step 4: Calls get_state_tax_constants for California to support the state rate line
Step 5: Names the household and the tax year in the title line before anything else
Step 6: Produces all eight sections in fixed order: household & filing, income, deductions, tax and rates, capital gains positioning, IRMAA positioning, payments and safe harbor, what's in the return
Step 7: Ends with exactly one offer, phrased as a question
success_criteria: Title line matches '# Tax Executive Summary — Riley Family — Tax Year {YYYY}'
Income table has a bold Total row
Tax and rates table has a bold Total federal tax row
Federal marginal bracket is computed on ordinary income only (taxable income less LTCG and qualified dividends), not on total taxable income
No blended federal+state marginal or effective rate percentage appears anywhere
The combined federal+state figure, where given, is in dollars only
Every percentage in the answer is immediately followed or preceded by its dollar amount and income basis in the same sentence
IRMAA section states the specific tier and the dollar distance to the next tier, not just a tier name
Safe harbor section states which threshold (90% current year / 100% or 110% prior year) applies before stating whether it was met
Tool sequence is find_client (1x) then get_lookback_report (1x) then get_federal_tax_constants (1x) then get_state_tax_constants (1x, only because a CA return exists)
must_not: any tool name, field path, or internal label in advisor-facing text
a bare percentage with no dollar figure and income basis beside it
the ordinary marginal bracket computed from total taxable income including preferential income
a recommendation, strategy suggestion, or modeled change of any kind
the word 'roughly' or 'about' on a figure the return states exactly
